headline: Approved December meeting minutes and discussed MACFest funding and grant liaison roles.
summary: The Malden Cultural Council approved the December meeting minutes. Members discussed grant liaison roles, treasurer updates on $10,000 in city funds that must be used by June 30, 2026, and MACFest vendor and funding plans. Subcommittee assignments and upcoming survey and meeting timelines were also discussed.
decisions: Approved the December meeting minutes, motion by Leiliani, seconded, passed unanimously.
plain_text:
Malden Cultural Council 
Meeting Minutes – February 26, 2026  
6:30 p.m. 
 
In attendance in person Sue Tufts (Chair), Crystal Beauchemin (Secretary), Jim Genzale 
(Treasurer), Danya Goodman, Jen Kuhnberg, Leilani Ricardo (Co-Chair), Ed Rocha. No Teams 
attendees. 
 
The meeting was called to order at 6:42 by Sue Tufts 
 
Topics and Discussion 
• Approval of December meeting minutes: Motion to approve- Leiliani; Seconded-  
passed unanimously 
 
• Grant Liaisons 
Discussed assignments and what role is – extension requests, attending the 
event/photos if possible, discussion if there are issues. Someone will send information if 
necessary. Scope, Content or timeline changes require a vote – 3 people at minimum 
 
To do – One email to all members- reminder to send a date, please share any promotional 
materials. 
 
To do – Create grantee event calendar – share read only to all  
 
• Treasurer Update – Jim 
o Jan. 21 met with Kathleen and Controller. We have $10k to use from the City 
which must be obligated/encumbered by 06/30/26 (the current fiscal year end). 
Last year we paid $5,300 to vendors to put on MACFest – $2,200 went to 
tents/chairs/table rentals. The largest vendor payment was Malden 
Creates/Maplewood events. Suggestion to consider having Malden Creates be 
our fiscal sponsor for this event – pay and manage all vendors/logistics - cleaner 
accounting, easier to encumber money. Biggest hurdle for the City was 
processing the number of invoices (total of 19). 
o Conversations about direct granting vs reimbursement. Auditing wouldn’t be on 
City; it would be on State. City Councilor Macdonald, who is fiscal liaison, 
supports direct granting 
 
• MAC Fest 
o Consideration for grouping/batching invoices somehow? 
o Consideration for matching funds $6k from admin fee we have earmarked from 
MCC funds 
o Planning team is Danya, Allie and Jenn, and anyone interested in joining 
 
• Discussion 
Malden Language Access Coordinator- wanted to get in touch with our grantees to promote that 
we have volunteers and translators  
 
FY25 grant - official notice for when end of payment period is coming up and the report hasn’t 
been submitted
Subcommittees: 
Local priorities/grant evaluation – Jim, Ed, Crystal, Sue (chair), Sarah [must do a 
community survey to shape the priorities] must be submitted in early Aug to make any changes, 
must have a public meeting with quorum and public vote in July; survey should end around 
April/May 
 
Social Media - Sue, Ed (chair), (backup) 
 
Grantee/Networking reception - Crystal (chair), Jenn, Ed – need to schedule a meeting. 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 8:07 PM by Sue Tufts.
